description.en: Hand-picked bundles for DeepSeek Harness: the balance whale widget, a word-selection translator, and a desktop pet.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的三个自用增强插件：余额小鲸鱼挂件、划词翻译、桌面宠物。

plugins.name: @tuweizhi/dsh-whale-widget
plugins.description: DSH Web 界面右下角的 DeepSeek 余额小鲸鱼挂件:余额/今日已用/峰谷定价、自定义泡泡点击序列(文本/余额/今日/峰谷/图片/随机语句与并列加权选择)、逐行样式与字体、悬浮快捷编辑、音效与每轮消耗、自定义角色/动图/音效、吸附与翻转自定义

plugins.name: @tuweizhi/dsh-translator
plugins.description: Youdao-style word-selection translation for the DSH web GUI. Select text anywhere, click the floating button, get a translation — by default through keyless public translation endpoints, with the harness's own LLM as the other engine. 有道风格划词翻译：DSH Web GUI

description.en: A pixel pet that lives in a corner of the DSH window: drag it around, it chatters on its own, throws tantrums and reacts to your work status.
description.zh: 住在 DSH 窗口角落里的桌面宠物：可拖拽、会自己碎碎念、会扔东西发脾气，也会跟着你的忙碌状态换动作。
